documentation.file_docstring:
Centralized exception hierarchy for AgentMesh.

All AgentMesh exceptions inherit from AgentMeshError, enabling
consistent error handling across integrations and core modules.
header_comments: Copyright (c) Agent-Mesh Contributors. All rights reserved.
member_docstrings: AgentMeshError: Base exception for all AgentMesh errors.
IdentityError: Errors related to agent identity (DID, keys, credentials).
TrustError: Errors related to trust scoring and verification.
TrustVerificationError: Trust verification failed during handshake or delegation.
TrustViolationError: Trust policy was violated during agent interaction.
DelegationError: Errors related to scope chains.
DelegationDepthError: Raised when scope chain exceeds the configured max depth.
GovernanceError: Errors related to governance policy enforcement.
HandshakeError: Errors during trust handshake protocol.
HandshakeTimeoutError: Raised when a trust handshake exceeds the configured timeout.
